scopeCoverage.note: The chip and its own slide-over are the whole surface scope; no shared guard with the finished-card strip.
One call fills the chip's line and the slide-over's rows.

places.name: Build board
places.description: The board the reader supervises: filters at the top, the finished-card strip, then the kanban. The release chip lives here, beside the filters.

places.name: Releases slide-over
places.description: A right-side panel over the board listing the last five releases of the selected project. The board stays visible and unblocked behind it.

affordances.name: Release chip
affordances.notes: Min-h-11 button beside the project and intent filters. Reads 'Releases · v0.99.0 · 28 Oct' with a project selected, 'Releases · v0.99.0 · 4 projects shipped' with none. Carries the loading, five absence sentences and the unreadable state in its own label.

affordances.name: Release row
affordances.notes: One row per release: version, day, takeaway clamped to two lines. Expands in place to the full takeaway text; a release without notes shows a fixed phrase.

affordances.name: projectReleases
affordances.notes: Validated RPC taking {projectId: string|null}; null means the fleet. Every scalar present, no optional keys omitted.

affordances.name: readProjectReleases
affordances.notes: Strict git reader: for-each-ref for the tag spine, git show <tag>:CHANGELOG.md only for a project whose slide-over is open. Ten-second per-command timeout, four-megabyte buffer, aggregate deadline, typed failures.

affordances.name: selectReleases
affordances.notes: Pure: filters tags through parseReleaseTag, parses changelog headings, matches notes by exact normalized version, orders by day then version text, extracts the takeaway, counts undocumented tags in the window.

affordances.name: projectRoot
affordances.notes: Resolves a project's default source path; its single null is split by the reader into no-repo and path-missing.

affordances.name: git tags and CHANGELOG.md
affordances.notes: The only source of record. Tags give version and day; the changelog at that tag gives the notes. Nothing is persisted into the plugin.
